notes: Microchip PD-9501GC/AC-US is a single-port IEEE 802.3bt Type 3 Gigabit PoE midspan injector (compact desktop/wall-wart enclosure, 151x62x38mm, not rack-mountable - rackUnits omitted). Category/type: it doesn't cleanly fit any predefined AV "type" (it's not a switch/router, just an inline PoE inserter), so type is set to "Other" under category "network". Confirmed via Microchip's own datasheet DS00004045 (rev A, English, and rev B, the Japanese "AC-JP" sell sheet with product photography) plus the live Microchip product page (microchip.com/en-us/product/PD-9501GC) and DigiKey's distributor spec table for the exact PD-9501GC-AC-US SKU - all agree on specs. The two front-panel RJ45 ports are physically labeled "DATA IN" and "DATA PWR OUT" (confirmed from a manufacturer product photo); per task convention both are marked bidirectional as RJ45 ports even though functionally one is data-only in and the other is data+PoE out. Net weight is listed inconsistently across Microchip's own literature: 500g in the English datasheet vs 340g "body only" in the Japanese sell sheet (likely cord/packaging inclusion difference) - not port-relevant but flagged for completeness. Microchip's website (microchip.com and ww1.microchip.com) blocks generic automated fetches (Akamai bot protection returned 403 on direct requests); the datasheet content was verified via an official-document mirror hosted by an authorized Japanese distributor (Tachibana Eletech) carrying the identical Microchip DS00004045 document, cross-checked against DigiKey's own transcription of Microchip's spec sheet for the AC-US part.

ports.name: DATA IN
ports.note: Uplink RJ45 from the network switch/router; passes 10/100/1000BASE-T data only, no PoE.

ports.name: DATA PWR OUT
ports.note: Downlink RJ45 to the powered device; carries data plus injected PoE (IEEE 802.3bt Type 3, up to 60W guaranteed user-port power, 55VDC nominal, delivered over all 4 pairs; data pairs 1/2(-),3/6(+), spare pairs 7/8(-),4/5(+)). Backward-compatible with 802.3af/at.

ports.name: AC In
ports.note: AC mains inlet, 100-240VAC 50/60Hz, 1.5A. Ships with a detachable, region-specific power cord (the /AC-US suffix denotes the US cord; /AC-EU, /AC-UK, /AC-JP variants exist, plus a cordless 'PD-9501GC/AC' body-only SKU) - the detachable, interchangeable-cord design and product photography indicate an IEC C5/C6 'cloverleaf' 3-pin appliance inlet on the unit; the datasheet text itself only states the input voltage/current and does not name the connector explicitly.
